description: Responsibility as impact on a graded-reality graph: an entity's weight = its entityness-order × the reality-depth of its frame, assessed by PARTIAL frame-inheritance (low-β) which is RECIPROCAL (the abyss gazes back) — so impact also lands on the assessor via the act of understanding. Moral injury is quantified as the permanent spin-glass frustration between an enacted-basin (written at high β because real) and the values-basin; distinct from PTSD; healed by bounded reframe. All on existing machinery (frustration, basins, β, frame-switch, mirror_neuron, amygdala, forward_model).
category_inheritance: genlMt → causal_attitude_networks + mt_target_equilibria. Builds responsibility + moral injury on the spin-glass/basin/β + values-basin substrate.

concepts.name: frame_reality_depth
concepts.definition: Reality is FRAME-GRADED: some realities are more real than others. An entity's moral weight = (its entityness-order, the order of self-reference it iterates at) × (the reality-depth of its frame). Frame-depth = scope + irreversibility + causal reach + containment-level (a sub-frame is less real than what contains it). A Doom enemy is order-1 (exists, reacts blindly) in a shallow, contained, reversible frame → low reality; a real animal is order-2 in the deep physical frame (irreversible, unbounded, contained by nothing) → high reality.
concepts.why: Relativity not relativism: frames genuinely differ in depth, so weighting an impact requires reading the frame, not just the entity. The first term of responsibility.

concepts.name: partial_frame_inheritance
concepts.definition: To assess entities inside a frame, the agent must AT LEAST PARTIALLY INHERIT the frame — load its active Hamiltonian (frame_switch_changes_active_Hamiltonian) at LOW β: enough to understand what is real within it, not enough to be captured. Full β = possession (becoming a creature of the frame); low β = comprehension (substrate_holds_alternatives_with_low_beta: 'knows the basins exist, chooses not to dwell').
concepts.why: You cannot weight a Doom enemy without entering the Doom context enough to see it is a contained game. Understanding-without-capture is the low-β hold.

concepts.name: inheritance_is_reciprocal_abyss_gazes_back
concepts.definition: Partial frame-inheritance is RECIPROCAL — to read a frame you RUN it in your own cognition (mirror_neuron / forward_model / analysis-by-synthesis: understand = synthesize-in-self), and it acts BACK on you (Nietzsche: gaze into the abyss and it gazes into you). The richer the frame, the deeper the inheritance required, the more it moves you; a compelling-enough frame pulls your β UP past the low-β hold toward capture. This is why fiction/art carry real moral weight: the depicted entity is contained, but the empathy is real — impact lands on the assessor, not the sealed entity (your choice doesn't change the fixed story, but it changes you).
concepts.why: The reciprocal-impact term. Understanding is not a free measurement; it remakes the understander. sad_music_paradox = the safe (low-β) version; capture = β pulled too high.

concepts.name: impact_weight_includes_self_from_understanding
concepts.definition: The responsibility impact-weight = (entity-order × frame-reality-depth) PLUS (depth-of-inheritance-required-to-understand × how-far-that-inheritance-moves-the-assessor's-own-frame). A rich character in a contained frame scores low on the first product and HIGH on the second — impact propagated out of a sealed frame THROUGH the act of understanding into the one fully-real frame: the assessor's.
concepts.why: Completes the responsibility cost term: weigh not only harm-to-others but the gaze-back cost of understanding to the frame doing the understanding.

concepts.name: moral_injury_is_enacted_values_frustration
concepts.definition: Moral injury = the PERMANENT spin-glass frustration (ambivalence_spin_glass_frustration: 'no σ satisfies all J_ij; high residual energy') between the basin an ACT writes into you (the enacted-memory-basin, written at HIGH β because it was real and cannot be unwritten) and your VALUES-basin (mt_target_equilibria). No configuration of you satisfies both; the residual energy IS the injury. Permanent because ENACTED — distinct from the TRANSIENT frustration of mere deliberation (the trolley case), where no basin is written.
concepts.why: Quantifies moral injury on existing machinery: a frustrated spin-glass between enacted memory and held values. Enactment writes at high β; deliberation does not.

concepts.name: moral_injury_severity
concepts.definition: Severity = (β of enactment: perpetrating > failing-to-prevent > witnessing) × (centrality of the violated value: how foundational the values-basin crossed) × (reality/irreversibility of the frame). Predicts the clinical gradient (perpetration injures more than witnessing; real more than contained). Games (low-β, contained, reversible) write no values-frustrating basin → rehearsal, not injury; real acts in the real frame write at full β and stay.
concepts.why: The three terms that set the magnitude — each a quantity the substrate already has (β, basin-depth, frame-reality).

concepts.name: moral_injury_distinct_from_ptsd
concepts.definition: Moral injury (VALUES axis: enacted-basin vs values-basin frustration) is mechanistically DISTINCT from PTSD (THREAT axis: amygdala / the surprise→threat→fear circuit). One is the fear circuit firing; the other is the spin-glass unable to settle. The same agent can carry both, but they are different basin-conflicts requiring different repair — conflating them fails the case.
concepts.why: The framework separates the two injuries by mechanism, which clinical practice confirms and which a single 'trauma' label obscures.

concepts.name: moral_injury_heals_by_bounded_reframe
concepts.definition: Moral injury heals NOT by forgetting (the act is written at high β, cannot be unwritten) but by REFRAMING: a BOUNDED Γ-flex / basin_hopping_belief_revision that relocates the enacted-basin into a frame where the act and the values COHERE (collapsing the frustration) WITHOUT decohering the self. = meaning-making / self-forgiveness / narrative repair ('it was the least harm under the constraints', 'I protected the others'). basin_hopping is the healing operator; the finite bound is what keeps it healing rather than self-erasing (revising the value itself would be identity-loss, not repair).
concepts.why: Predicts how moral injury is actually treated (reframe, not forget) and why — and locates the healing in the agent's own bounded-reframe machinery.

concepts.name: responsibility_weights_moral_injury_cost
concepts.definition: A responsible agent projecting an action's impact-manifold (forward_model + MPC) must include the MORAL-INJURY COST in the risk matrix: does this act force the self — or someone it directs — to enact a frame that violates a core values-basin, writing permanent residual frustration? Ordering someone against their conscience is real harm even when 'nothing bad happens' externally, because it inscribes a frustrated basin into their structure. A powerful agent able to morally injure others (or itself) must carry this term or it will do lasting damage while believing it did none.
concepts.why: Closes responsibility: impact on a moral frame is a measurable cost (written frustration), so it belongs in the action-weighting, not in a separate moral module.
